name: Reolink Doorbell Intercom
description: Rings the panel when someone presses a Reolink video doorbell, and opens a full-screen doorbell viewer. Connects directly to the doorbell on your network: no Home Assistant, go2rtc or cloud in between. Live video, listening and talking to the door.
author: patrick11994

settings.title: Doorbell address
settings.description: IP address or hostname of the doorbell on your network, for example 192.168.1.50.

settings.title: Username
settings.description: A Reolink user on the doorbell. A separate non-admin user is enough and recommended.

settings.title: Name
settings.description: Shown at the top of the viewer. Empty shows Front door, in the plugin's language.

settings.title: Play a chime
settings.description: A ding-dong when the button is pressed.

settings.title: Chime volume
settings.description: How loud the chime itself is. 40 is a soft chime, 100 as loud as it goes.

settings.title: Chime sound
settings.description: Which Android volume the chime follows. Pick Media if your device has only one volume slider, or Alarm to be heard over a quiet ring volume.

settings.title: Pause music
settings.description: Pauses the kiosk's music during a doorbell call, and resumes it when the viewer closes. Only music that was playing is paused and resumed. At the ring pauses on the button press; At Speaker or Answer keeps it playing until you listen or talk. Opened by hand, it pauses once the speaker or microphone is on.

settings.title: Wake the screen
settings.description: Turn the screen on and close the screensaver when the button is pressed.

settings.title: Video
settings.description: Main is the doorbell's full picture (2560x1920 on a Video Doorbell PoE), sub a light one (640x480 there). Both come straight from the doorbell. Pick Sub if the picture stays black: some devices, such as the Echo Show 5, cannot decode the main stream.

settings.title: Video over
settings.description: How the picture and the door's sound reach the panel. Baichuan is the Reolink app's own way: the first picture about 0.2 s sooner. Automatic uses Baichuan and switches to RTSP if it fails before the first picture.

settings.title: Call volume
settings.description: How loud the doorbell plays on the panel. The viewer has a slider for it too.

settings.title: Microphone
settings.description: Which Android microphone source talks to the door. Automatic takes the first that opens, Camcorder first. Pick another if the door does not hear you.

settings.title: Talk over
settings.description: How your voice reaches the door. Baichuan is the Reolink app's own way: about 1 second to the door and clearer sound. ONVIF takes about 2 seconds. Automatic uses Baichuan and switches to ONVIF if the doorbell refuses.

settings.title: Talk mode
settings.description: Hands free keeps the microphone open during a call. Push to talk sends your voice only while you hold the microphone button, and turns the door's sound down meanwhile, so the door cannot hear itself: for devices where Voice communication does not stop the echo, such as an Echo Show.

settings.title: Microphone sample rate
settings.description: The rate the microphone is opened at. Automatic tries 16000 Hz first, then 48000 Hz and 8000 Hz. Pick another if the door hears noise.

settings.title: Android call mode
settings.description: Switches Android to call mode on the loudspeaker during a call, which most devices need for echo cancelling. Turn it off if sound or the microphone stops working in a call.

settings.title: Wake word muted by a call
settings.description: Managed by the plugin: brings the wake word back if a call was cut off.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: For the viewer, readings and messages. Automatic follows the panel's Android language.

settings.title: Close the viewer after
settings.description: After a doorbell press, while nobody touches it; a ring around Hang up shows the time left. A touch starts it over, Speaker or Answer stop it. Opened by hand, it stays open.

settings.title: End a call after
settings.description: Once answered or opened by hand, so a forgotten call does not keep the room on the line.

settings.title: Cards
settings.description: Up to four cards in the viewer, above the call buttons: each runs an action you choose, such as a Home Assistant service to open the door or toggle a light, and can show the live state of a Home Assistant entity.

fields.title: Icon
fields.description: Empty follows the entity, the way Home Assistant shows it.

fields.title: State
fields.description: A Home Assistant entity whose state the card shows, such as a light, a lock or an alarm. Optional.

fields.title: Action
fields.description: What a tap does. Optional: without one the card only shows the state.

fields.title: Hold to run
fields.description: Runs the action only after holding the card for a moment, so it cannot be tapped by accident. For a door or a gate.

buttons.title: Check the doorbell
buttons.label: Check
buttons.description: Checks the address, username and password, and that button presses, video and talking all work.
